info.title: Pathbase API
info.description:
HTTP API for Pathbase — repositories, agent trace paths, computation graphs, and anonymous share links.

**Stability.** v1 endpoints are stable in shape; additive changes (new fields, new endpoints, broader query params) ship without a version bump. Breaking changes get a new prefix (`/api/v2/...`) and a deprecation window.

**Spec format.** OpenAPI 3.1, served live at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. The `x-pathbase-version` response header on every call carries the running build's `<semver>+<git-sha>` so consumers can pin or correlate.

**Auth.** Most endpoints require a Pathbase session cookie or a `pat_…` bearer token (see the `bearerAuth` scheme). Unauthenticated endpoints — the `Anon` and `Signups` namespaces, public profile reads — are clearly tagged. Per-operation `security` annotations reflect the actual gate enforced by the handler.

post.summary:
Upload a single-path Graph document anonymously. Stored under the
shared `anon` user; the response carries a UUID-based `share_url`
the uploader can hand out. Per-IP rate-limited and capped by
`body_limits.anon_upload_bytes`.

400.description: Invalid document / unsupported variant / empty path

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured anon upload byte limit

get.summary: Read an anon-uploaded trace by its UUID. No auth, no rate limit.
get.description:
The handler explicitly overrides the global `Cache-Control` and
`Vary` defaults: anon responses don't depend on the `Authorization`
header (the endpoint ignores it), so the auth-keyed cache defaults
would needlessly fragment any CDN/proxy cache.

404.description: No anon path with that ID

post.summary:
Second half of the CLI browser-login flow. Redeems a one-time code
for a long-lived `pat_…` bearer token bound to a `cli` session. No
auth required — the code is the credential.

First half of the CLI browser-login flow. The signed-in browser
asks for a short, human-readable code that the user types into a
CLI (`pathbase login`); the CLI then redeems it for a long-lived
bearer token via `/auth/cli/redeem`.

get.summary:
Local-development sign-in shortcut — creates / signs in as `dev`.
Disabled (400) when GitHub OAuth is configured, so it can never
fire in production.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Same-origin relative path to land on after sign-in.

302.description: Redirect after signing in as the local `dev` user

get.summary:
Start the GitHub OAuth handshake — issue a 302 to GitHub's
`authorize` URL with `state` carrying the validated `redirect`.
Falls back to `/api/v1/auth/dev` when GitHub OAuth is unconfigured.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Same-origin relative path to land on after sign-in. Bad values are silently dropped (open-redirect defense).

302.description: Redirect to GitHub authorize URL (or to `/api/v1/auth/dev` when GitHub OAuth is unconfigured)

get.summary:
GitHub OAuth callback — exchange the `code` for a token, look up or
create the matching Pathbase user, and redirect to the validated
`state` target (or `/`).

302.description: Redirect after creating or linking the Pathbase account

post.summary:
Sign in with email + password. Sets `pb_session` cookie. Returns
the user; for the bearer token instead, use the CLI grant flow.

Invalidate the caller's session (cookie or bearer-token) and clear
the `pb_session` cookie. Idempotent — succeeds even with no session.

Create a new account with username + email + password and sign the
caller in. Sets `pb_session` cookie and creates the default
`pathstash` repo for quick uploads.

get.summary:
List the caller's active sessions (web + CLI). The session that
issued the request is flagged `is_current`.

delete.summary:
Revoke a specific session by ID. 404 (not 401/403) for sessions
owned by other users — keeps the existence of those sessions
invisible to the caller.

404.description: Session not found or not owned by the caller

get.summary:
Liveness + readiness probe — confirms the database is reachable.
Returns 503 (still as JSON) when the round-trip fails so an
orchestrator can distinguish "process up, dependency down" from
"process down."

post.summary:
Create a new repository owned by the caller. Names are unique per
owner; collisions return 409.

example.description: Agent runs from the rebuild week
example.name: my-traces

409.description: A repo with this name already exists for the caller

get.summary:
Fetch a repository by `owner/name`. Public read; the contained
paths/graphs enforce their own visibility on read.

delete.summary:
Delete a repository, cascading to all paths and graphs it contains.
Owner-only.

patch.summary:
Update a repo's mutable fields. Only the owner may call this;
non-owners get 401.

get.summary: List graphs in a repo. Public read.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Max items to return. Default and cap are server-configurable;
out-of-range values are clamped silently.

post.summary:
Upload a multi-path Graph document. Inline paths (`PathOrRef::Path`)
are persisted as new TracePaths in the same repo, deduped by their
toolpath ID. Refs to existing paths are kept as-is. Caller must own
the repo.

get.summary:
Fetch a graph with its full reconstructed multi-path document.
Public read; constituent path visibility is enforced when those
paths are accessed individually.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Graph slug, or the graph's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

delete.summary:
Delete a graph. Owner only. Detaches but does not delete the
constituent TracePaths — those remain reachable as standalone paths.

get.summary:
List paths in a repo. Visibility-filtered: callers see all paths if
they own the repo, public paths only otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Max items to return. Default and cap are server-configurable;
out-of-range values are clamped silently.

post.summary:
Upload a single-path graph as a new path under `{owner}/{repo}`.
Multi-path graphs go to `POST .../graphs`. Caller must own the repo.

get.summary:
Fetch a path with its full reconstructed document. Visibility-gated:
private paths return 404 unless the caller owns the repo or
addressed the path by its UUID (the unguessable share-by-link form).
Conditional via `If-None-Match`.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Path slug, or the path's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

delete.summary: Delete a path. Owner only. Cascades to its step rows.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Path slug, or the path's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

patch.summary:
Patch a path's mutable fields — currently just `is_public`. Owner
only. Use this to flip a private upload public for sharing.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Path slug, or the path's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

get.summary:
Render the path's HEAD-ancestor chain as a chat-projection — a
densely-indexed, pre-classified, optionally pre-rendered transcript.
Visibility-gated like `GET .../paths/{slug}`.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Path slug, or the path's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

parameters.name: include_html
parameters.description:
Render `text` and `thinking` fields to sanitized HTML server-side.
Defaults to true; set false for lighter payloads when the client
renders markdown lazily.

200.description: Chat-shaped projection of the path's HEAD-ancestor chain

get.summary:
Stream the path's reconstructed Graph document as raw JSON — the
inverse of `POST .../paths`. Visibility-gated; private paths return
404 unless owner-authenticated or addressed by UUID.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Path slug, or the path's UUID for unguessable share-by-link access

post.summary:
Capture an email + source pair from a marketing form. Idempotent
per (email, source); per-IP rate-limited; the response intentionally
carries no detail so a caller can't enumerate which addresses are
already on a list.

get.summary:
Return the authenticated caller's full profile, including their
email — fields no other endpoint exposes.

patch.summary:
Patch the caller's mutable profile fields. Unspecified fields are
left untouched; pass `null` to clear an optional field.

get.summary:
Return another user's public profile. Email is never included for
users other than the caller; use `/users/me` for the caller's own
full profile.

List a user's repositories. Public read; visibility filtering on
the contained paths/graphs happens at their respective endpoints,
not here.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Max items to return. Default and cap are server-configurable;
out-of-range values are clamped silently.

ActorView.description:
Resolved actor identity for a turn. Lookup happens once on the
server against the document's `meta.actors` block; turns reference
the actor by `u32` index into the projection's `actors` array.

display.description:
Display name resolved against `meta.actors` if present, else the
suffix after `:`.

path.description:
Site-relative path to the uploaded trace's frontend page, e.g.
`/anon/pathstash/paths/<uuid>`. Suitable for in-app navigation.

inserted.description: Number of steps newly inserted (existing `step_id`s are skipped).

ChatCursor.description:
Pagination cursor for fetching older turns. Reserved for future
`?before=<step_id>` requests; currently every projection returns the
full chain in one shot.

before.description:
Canonical step ID one step older than `turns[0]`. `None` when the
chain reaches a root step in this projection.

ChatProjection.description:
Top-level chat-projection response. Densely-indexed (`u32` IDs into
`turns` / `actors`) so JSON parsing is cheap and the wire shape
avoids duplicating actor strings on every turn.

head.description:
Index into `turns` — the latest turn along the HEAD chain. `None`
when the document has no head.

step_ids.description:
Canonical step IDs parallel to `turns`, for deep-links and
`/step/{id}` fetches.

ChatTurn.description:
One linearized turn along the HEAD-ancestor chain. Already
classified, optionally pre-rendered to HTML, with tool invocations
inlined — the renderer drops in `text_html` and renders no further.

invocations.description: `tool.invoke` siblings of an assistant step, spliced inline.

parent_id.description: Index into `turns` — `i - 1` along the HEAD chain, `None` at the root.

text_html.description:
Sanitized HTML for `text`. Empty when `include_html` is false or
`text` is empty.

tool_diff.description:
For `kind = "tool"` only: the first non-empty `change[k].raw`,
pre-split into lines.

ChatTurnKind.description:
Pre-classified turn kind. Server-side classification follows the
precedence rules in `packages/frontend/src/classify.ts`; the client
renders verbatim without re-deriving.

code.description: Display code the browser shows; the user types it into the CLI.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the grant expires (10 minutes).

Graph.description:
A computation graph — a named ordered collection of paths within a
repo. Stored as header metadata plus `(graph_id, path_id, position)`
junction rows; the full `document` is reconstructed on read.

document.description:
Reconstructed full Graph document with inline paths. Only populated
by handlers that explicitly fetch the constituent paths and steps.

header.description:
Stored graph metadata: `{graph: GraphIdentity, meta?: GraphMeta}` —
the toolpath `Graph` minus its `paths`. None when never set.

token.description:
Long-lived bearer token (`pat_…`). Send as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` from CLI calls.

password.description: Minimum 8 characters. Stored as an Argon2id hash.

username.description:
Lowercase ASCII alphanumerics, hyphens, and underscores. Must
not collide with the reserved `me` / `anon` namespaces.

Repo.description:
A repository — a named bucket of paths and graphs owned by a single
user. The `(owner_id, name)` pair is unique; `name` is also the
URL-segment ("alice/my-traces").

is_current.description:
Marks the session that issued the request; clients should warn
before letting the user revoke it (logs the current device out).

ToolDiff.description:
Pre-split diff payload — picked from the first non-empty
`change[k].raw` on a structural step. Lines are pre-split so the
renderer doesn't repeat the work.

ToolInvocation.description:
A `tool.invoke` step spliced inline next to its parent assistant
turn. Saves the client a second pass over the path's step graph.

input.description:
Tool input args from the structural payload (`extra.input`),
JSON-stringified when not already a string.

result.description:
Tool output from the structural payload (`extra.result`),
JSON-stringified when not already a string.

step_id.description: Canonical step ID of the tool.invoke step.

TracePath.description:
A single agent trace path within a repo. Stored in three pieces:
header metadata (here), step rows (in `path_steps`), and the
reconstructed full `document` (re-assembled on read for handlers
that need it).

document.description:
Reconstructed full Graph document. Only populated by handlers that
explicitly fetch the steps (e.g. single-path GET, download, chat).
Listing endpoints leave this None to avoid N+1 step fetches.

header.description:
Stored path metadata: `{path: PathIdentity, meta?: PathMeta}` — the
toolpath `Path` minus its `steps`. None when never set.

is_public.description: Defaults to true. Set false for secret/unlisted paths (e.g. pathstash).

User.description:
A registered Pathbase account. `email` is optional because GitHub
OAuth users can have a private email; CLI / API consumers see the
caller's own email via `/users/me` but never another user's.

bearerAuth.description: Pathbase personal access token (`pat_…`) obtained via the CLI grant flow (`POST /auth/cli/request-grant` then `POST /auth/cli/redeem`). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
